subject.title: [UX] Per-agent model override not surfaced in 'openclaw models' output or settings UI

question: Should model observability gain an explicit aggregate all-agent CLI view and an inherited-versus-overridden indicator on the Agents UI, or should operators continue using targeted agent status and raw configuration?
rationale: Source inspection establishes the missing aggregate presentation, but repository behavior does not define whether it belongs in the existing default output, a new flag, the Agents UI, or the global Settings page.

options.title: Add Explicit Aggregate View
options.body: Add an opt-in CLI flag or subcommand and an Agents UI indicator while preserving current default output and clearly separating configured and active models.

options.title: Enhance Existing Agent Surfaces
options.body: Keep model status agent-scoped and improve only `agents list` or the Agents UI with effective-model and override information.

options.title: Keep Targeted Diagnostics
options.body: Retain the current agent-specific command and raw-config workflow, documenting how operators inspect overrides without adding a new presentation surface.

recommendation.title: Add Explicit Aggregate View
recommendation.body: Add an opt-in CLI flag or subcommand and an Agents UI indicator while preserving current default output and clearly separating configured and active models.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal is the introduction of the model-status diagnostics surface that would define the public CLI contract.
